summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (joins objects with sep, prints via print with markup, emoji, and wrapping disabled, supporting style and highlight). Added four tests to tests/test_console.py, a CHANGELOG.md entry under 9.0.0 Added, and a docs section in docs/source/console.rst. Tests were not run, per instructions, so they are unverified; the style test's expected escape codes were written from memory. Nothing was committed.
